description.value: Falkland Store Ltd. is a convenience store serving the small community of Falkland, situated directly on the Okanagan Highway — a well-travelled cycling corridor connecting the Thompson and Okanagan regions. As one of the few retail stops in this rural stretch, it serves as a natural resupply point for touring cyclists passing through. The store accepts cash withdrawals on foreign cards, a handy feature for international cyclists.
